d: We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Solutions Lead with extensive experience in enterprise solution architecture, system implementation, integration, and cloud technologies. The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in designing and delivering complex technology solutions, with expertise across modern integration patterns, cloud-native architectures, APIs, and emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence. The successful candidate will have a deep understanding of the financial services industry and be responsible for translating business requirements into scalable, secure, and resilient technology solutions. This role will lead solution design across multiple banking platforms and initiatives, ensuring alignment with architectural standards, regulatory requirements, and strategic business objectives. In addition, the Technical Solutions Lead will serve as a key technology partner to both internal and external stakeholders, driving collaboration across business, product, operations, vendors, and technology teams to ensure the successful delivery and continuous evolution of the bank's technology landscape.

Minimum of a Bachelors Degree in Computer Science or related subject
